elaine: dropped new compact comps for streaming controls + prompt library insert. two variants: contextual mini-toolbar vs persistent onboarding rail. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/playground-stream (frames 1-4). quick takes? marc: mini-toolbar wins for returning users. feels less noisy while stream is live. olivia: copy: use "Stop" (primary), "Regenerate" (secondary), prompt action label "Insert". token label should read "Tokens used" when visible. ari: accessibility: streaming content needs aria-live="polite" and an offscreen assertive announcement on completion so SR users know controls appeared. toolbar must be reachable by keyboard in predictable order. sanjay: perf: append-only streaming DOM, avoid full re-renders. debounce token updates (300ms). SRs shouldn't hear token chimes constantly 12 announce on thresholds or completion. elaine: mini-toolbar is icon-only by default with hover labels; bottom rail is full text and meter. i'm leaning mini-toolbar for default and show bottom rail for first-run/onboarding. marc: agree on first-run bottom rail toggle. show a small hint that users can press Ctrl+. to pin/unpin controls. olivia: a11y contrast note: icon-only targets need 3:1 contrast and 44px hit area. add visible focus ring. ari: snippet for completion announce:
...
// on finish set done.textContent = 'Response complete. Controls available.' elaine: mobile: toolbar could overlap composer; will render inline compact row above composer on <480px. ux-bot: checklist: keyboard nav; aria-live; completion announce; token label; focus after actions; mobile layout. elaine: thanks all 12 ill iterate and post updates tomorrow. if anyone strongly prefers persistent rail as the only pattern speak up now. :thumbsup:
